title: Remote work removed the structure ADHD brains relied on: intro to an ADHD productivity episode
summary: Dustin Howes frames an Affiliate Nerd Out episode with a guest who holds a full-time job and an influencer side hustle with ADHD. The short post argues that the shift to remote work stripped away external structure and left ADHD workers without support. The guest's actual tips are not included.

principles.text: Remote work quietly removed the external structure that once held a workday together.
principles.quote: Our industry went fully remote and quietly removed every external structure that once held a workday together.

principles.text: Remote work succeeded on trust, not training: employers assumed people were responsible enough to manage it.
principles.quote: No one trained us to work remotely; employers had to trust we were responsible enough to do it.

principles.text: Productivity apps don't fix the problem for ADHD workers; remote work without structure sets them up to fail.
principles.quote: Apps were created to make you more productive, but ADHDoers were thrown into a world with a recipe for failure.
